images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one landscape illustration for the opening page of a Spanish primary-school book about the water cycle. Traditional hand-painted watercolor and fine sepia ink on warm ivory paper, gentle natural colors, muted sage vegetation, blue water, warm ochre sunlight, delicate paper texture, clear charming educational book illustration. Scene: sunny mountain landscape with a winding river flowing downhill into a lake, trees, distant snowy peaks, a cloud raining over a hill while the sun shines elsewhere. Wide composition about 4:3, generous clean ivory margins, no frame. No words, labels, letters, logos or watermark. Smooth organic shapes and fine natural detail, absolutely no pixel art, no 8-bit shapes, no neon palette, no digital UI. This is a flat printed illustration, not a photo of a book.
